g.text: FastAPI /rank, Redis cache and fallback, bounded concurrency, version pinning, promotion/rollback and shadow

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #575757

g.text: isolation were implemented and checked. Server and load generator ran on the same Mac; these short runs are

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #575757

g.text: not a sustained production capacity claim. The latest response model still needs a live feedback adapter and its own

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #575757

g.text: HTTP load validation before promotion. Real receipt-time logging and an online A/B experiment remain outstanding.
